newsitem.title: USA: Vastar plans $585 million capital spending.
newsitem.headline: Vastar plans $585 million capital spending.

text.p: Vastar Resources Inc said Wednesday that it intends to profitably double reserves per share by 2001 and intends to average double-digit annual production growth.

The company also said that its capital program is expected to be $3.4 billion over the next five years. This year Vastar plans to invest $585 million to support its overall growth strategies with a strong emphasis on core operating areas.

Vastar will hold about 60 deepwater blocks if all apparent successful bids from the Central Gulf of Mexico Lease Sale 166 are awarded, it said. It's current plans are to begin drilling before year-end with the Ocean Victory, a rig the company has under contract for the next three years.
Vastar finds, develops, produces and markets natural gas and liquid hydrocarbons.
